_doc: Held-out blind test set for Task 4 / Multimodal Performance evaluation. Each entry pairs a diagram path with an `accept` list — any of the synonyms is treated as a correct identification by vlm_node. Diagrams span 5 anatomical categories (CNS structure, sensory map, cortical map, muscle group, hand anatomy) so the test isn't biased toward peripheral-nerve recognition.

diagrams._note: The Gray's Anatomy plate shows cutaneous nerves of the upper limb labelled with their dermatome levels (C5, C6, C8.T1, etc.). Both 'dermatomes' and 'cutaneous nerves of the upper limb' are medically correct identifications — the diagram literally encodes both.
accept: cutaneous nerves of the upper limb
cutaneous innervation of the upper limb

diagrams._note: Replaced the original `carpal_tunnel.png` entry: that file (despite its name) actually depicts a palmar dissection of hand intrinsic muscles + tendons rather than a carpal-tunnel cross-section, which biased the test. `hand_intrinsic_muscles.png` has a clean unambiguous gold label.
